title: Diffyscan Repository Profile
description: MethodDescription extras for Diffyscan verification of one source repository. Addresses and source url/commit remain ledger-owned; this profile supplies relative_root, dependencies, and optional commit-scoped overrides.

commits.description: Commit-scoped settings. A commit MUST be pinned here to be rendered: an absent commit blocks its cohort rather than falling back to default, so that each revision's dependency set is acknowledged explicitly. A pinned key replaces the matching default key outright (a commit-scoped dependencies object replaces the whole default map, it is not deep-merged); an empty object inherits default unchanged. Commit hex is matched case-insensitively.

fail_on_bytecode_comparison_error.description: Only meaningful when false (Diffyscan already defaults to true).
